raw_model_deviations.issue: “produced exactly this kind of surprise” together with the title and lead presents a specific caller discovering that a call they thought was AI was actually handled by a person. The Ledger confirms that trained contract workers handled some Muse calls, but does not confirm this particular discovery or caller experience; the Japanese source frames it as a scenario the test evokes, while the English version asserts that the test produced it.
raw_model_deviations.explanation: The English wording turns an illustrative scenario into a specific asserted experience. This is a translation-level increase in certainty and scope; changed_fact and unsupported_new_claim are also true because that experience is not established by the Ledger.
same_fact_id_locations: I Thought It Was an AI Call—But There Was a Person Inside? Meta’s Unexpected Muse Test
A call came from an AI agent. That was what it seemed. But while the conversation continued, the voice on the other end was not AI. It was a person.
violation_spans: produced exactly this kind of surprise.

raw_model_deviations.issue: The claim that a person can take over specifically when AI has trouble adds an unverified handoff trigger. The Ledger confirms that trained contractors handled some Muse calls, but not that they took over because the AI encountered difficulty.
raw_model_deviations.explanation: The claim adds a specific condition linking AI difficulty to human takeover. It appears in the Japanese source as well, so it is not a translation-added deviation.
violation_spans: A person can take over when AI alone has trouble.

raw_model_deviations.issue: The article asserts, as general facts about people, that knowing a person is listening changes how they feel and makes private details easier to share. The Ledger records employee privacy concerns about possible information sharing, but does not establish these general behavioral claims.
raw_model_deviations.explanation: These are new generalizations beyond the Ledger’s report of concerns in the specific test; changed_fact, changed_scope, and unsupported_new_claim apply.
violation_spans: People feel differently when they think they are speaking to a machine and when they know a person is listening.
Names, plans, and private matters are easier to share when you know who is hearing them.
